source_doc.title: NVIDIA Announces Spectrum-X Photonics, Co-Packaged Optics Networking Switches (GTC 2025-03-18) — Fabrinet addendum
source_doc.permission_basis: Official public NVIDIA press release; canonical URL retained, only research-relevant excerpts stored.

sources.quote: NVIDIA’s silicon photonics ecosystem includes TSMC, Browave, Coherent, Corning Incorporated, Fabrinet, Foxconn, Lumentum, SENKO, SPIL, Sumitomo Electric Industries and TFC Communication.

NVIDIA photonics will drive massive growth for a new wave of state-of-the-art AI factories, alongside pluggable optical transceiver technologies supported by industry leaders including Coherent, Eoptolink, Fabrinet and Innolight.

claims.statement: NVIDIA (customer side) publicly named Fabrinet as a member of its silicon photonics ecosystem for the Spectrum-X/Quantum-X co-packaged optics platforms, alongside TSMC, Browave, Coherent, Corning, Foxconn, Lumentum, SENKO, SPIL, Sumitomo Electric and TFC Communication.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if NVIDIA's subsequent ecosystem disclosures drop Fabrinet, or if the CPO supply chain is later disclosed without Fabrinet participation.

claims.statement: NVIDIA (customer side) named Fabrinet among the pluggable optical transceiver industry leaders (with Coherent, Eoptolink and Innolight) supporting its AI-factory buildout alongside NVIDIA photonics.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if later NVIDIA disclosures exclude Fabrinet from named transceiver suppliers.
